name: EDM audio
author: Ryan Lucas (drlucas)
description: Basic RDS support for the EDM

privacy.summary: Sends the station name and the playing song's artist and title to your EDM FM transmitter, which broadcasts them as RDS text to any radio in range. Nothing goes online.

sends.what: the station name you set and the artist and title of the song playing
sends.why: so car and home radios tuned to your FM transmitter show them as RDS text

privacy.other: Talks to the transmitter's RDS chip over two GPIO pins on this device; it does not transmit anything itself. The 'RDS Install' command saves settings into the transmitter's own memory, which stays changed after the plugin is removed. Your settings in config/plugin.fpp-edmrds are kept after uninstall.
